# `try_to_number`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Convert string 'expr' to a number based on the string format `fmt`.
Returns NULL if the string 'expr' does not match the expected format. The format follows the
same semantics as the to_number function.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
try_to_number(expr, fmt)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_to_number, example 1
> SELECT try_to_number('454', '999');
454
```

```sql
-- try_to_number, example 2
> SELECT try_to_number('454.00', '000.00');
454.00
```

```sql
-- try_to_number, example 3
> SELECT try_to_number('12,454', '99,999');
12454
```

```sql
-- try_to_number, example 4
> SELECT try_to_number('$78.12', '$99.99');
78.12
```

```sql
-- try_to_number, example 5
> SELECT try_to_number('12,454.8-', '99,999.9S');
-12454.8
```
